name: colloq
description: One link, one live notebook, one AI. Self-hosted workspace for technical seminars.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @colloq/server & npm run dev -w @colloq/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @colloq/web && npm run build -w @colloq/server && npm run build -w @colloq/runtime
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @colloq/server && npm run typecheck -w @colloq/web && npm run typecheck -w @colloq/runtime
